items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PolyShell)
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows attackers to achieve remote code execution by sending a crafted cookie.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical and important vulnerabilities, including stored cross-site scripting via server-side template injection, reflected XSS, and a one-click account takeover issue.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass security controls and gain unauthorized write access.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including stored XSS leading to arbitrary code execution and path traversal leading to arbitrary file system write.
